title: Judiciary Begins Demolition of Gohardasht Prison in Karaj
detail: Iran's Prisons Organization began demolishing Gohardasht Prison (also known as Rajai Shahr) in Karaj on September 13, 2026. The organization's head said the work was carried out 'by explicit order of Judiciary leadership' and would be 'completed within a month.' Human rights monitors have linked the demolition to a broader pattern of destroying physical evidence at Iranian detention and mass-grave sites this year, including the bulldozing of Plot 41 at Behesht-e Zahra cemetery and sites in Khavaran, Tabriz, Mashhad and Ahvaz — prompting more than 1,100 family members of victims to send a formal protest letter to the United Nations.

media.caption: Iran Human Rights Monitor reports on the demolition of Gohardasht Prison and destruction of evidence at mass-grave sites

confidenceReason: Reported by an opposition-aligned Iranian diaspora human rights monitor; not independently corroborated by wire services given restricted access to Iranian prisons.
